candidates.name: La Boca Walking Tour
candidates.description: A 2-hour guided walking tour through the La Boca neighborhood, starting at the corner of Magallanes and Caminito. The route includes walking the famous Caminito street, viewing the colorful houses and the monument to Benito Quinquela Martín, visiting the Volunteer Firefighters Plaza, and ending at the Boca Juniors stadium.
candidates.shortReason: Evidence explicitly describes a walking tour itinerary that includes Caminito, Volunteer Firefighters Plaza, and Boca Juniors stadium as sequential stops.
